summary: 36 units (37-72). Split, grammar and translation are mostly sound and cautious; damaged units (49, 62) are handled as the glossary says. Errors (4): u39 Hindi adds 'जैसे'; u59 and u67 the token 'kakṣādharāṇi' / 'kūrparāṇyurvī' hides the marma āṇi (kakṣādhara+āṇi, kūrpara+āṇi), so the draft's neuter-plural split omits a marma from the lists and the printed counts 27 and 44 do not work (27 works exactly with āṇi 4; 44 needs āṇi 4 and aṃsa 2); u62 'samarātra (probably a full day and night)' is an unsupported sense (probably saptarātra by pta/ma confusion) and is now marked unclear. Minor: gram labels (u37, u38, u48, u57), Hindi wording (u40, u42, u44, u63, u67), hedges beside names (u60, u62), flag consistency (u72), kaṭīkataruṇa gloss (u60). Count checks recorded in notes: all printed counts reconcile with the limb/trunk units of chunk 1 (flesh 11 = 4+4+1+2; sirā 41; snāyu 27 with āṇi; asthi 8; sandhi 20; sadyaḥprāṇahara 19 only if 'gudaba stanābhi' is gudabasti-nābhi; kālāntara 33 if 'vakṣomarma' means the eight chest marmas of u23-26; viśalyaghna 3; rujākara 8; vaikalyakara 44 needs aṃsa 2 besides the printed names). Head marmas of u37-46 (23) plus neck (14, chunk 1) = 37, which supports chunk 1's conjecture saptatriṃśat in u3. No identification judged wrong; probable ones are tagged and hedged. Units needing a human decision: u62 (stana, samarātra, gudaba), u63 (vakṣomarma), u67 (aṃsa), u58 (alāpa=apālāpa), u38 (pratibaddham agreement), u66 (by/at), copula policy in u44-46,67. No regrouping needed; 51-54 read as one connected passage, 55-56 introduce 57-61, 64 continues 63, 66 explains 65.
